tools.name: search_teaching_jobs
tools.description: Search live school vacancies on EduAtlas: teaching and leadership posts, plus support roles, which are marked (UK, Ireland, international schools worldwide). Free text works: "physics teacher London", "IB maths Dubai", "SENCO", "Lehrperson Zürich". The word "IB" limits results to IB World Schools. R

tools.name: schools_hiring
tools.description: Which schools are hiring right now in a country (optionally a city, and a subject or role word), ranked by number of live vacancies. Answers "which schools in Leeds are recruiting science teachers" with school names, counts and page URLs.

tools.name: find_jobs_for_me
tools.description: Live school vacancies ranked for one teacher's profile — for "here is my CV, what is live now that fits me?". findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_teaching_jobs, get_school · Private data: get_school, find_jobs_for_me · Public sink: get_school, find_jobs_for_me.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_teaching_jobs, get_school · Private data: get_school, find_jobs_for_me · Public sink: get_school, find_jobs_for_me

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
